title: Screen metadata
description: The metadata and the expected result of one measured terminal screen. The file sits beside <slug>.screen.

schema.description: The version of this schema that the file follows.

agent.description: The agent that drew the screen. It must equal the folder name under corpus/.

agent_version.description: The version of the agent that drew the screen.

valid_from.description: The first agent version that draws this screen, when it is known.

superseded_by.description: The slug of the screen that replaces this one in later agent versions.

capture.description: plain: capture-pane -p. styled: capture-pane -p -e, with SGR escape codes.

pane.description: The size of the pane at the capture. The length of a rule and the wrap depend on it. A measured screen must give it. An edited or derived screen gives it when the size is known.

provenance.description: measured: the bytes as captured. measured-edited: captured, then edited (list each edit). derived: hand-built, or made from another screen.

edits.description: One line for each edit of a measured-edited screen.

derived_from.description: For a derived screen: the source slug and what changed, or the word hand-built.

description.description: What the screen shows, and why it is in the corpus.

state.description: The state that a reader must give for this screen.

dialog.description: The kind of dialog, when the screen shows one.

question.description: The question text, only where the screen pins it.

options.description: The options of the dialog, in screen order.

n.description: The number on the screen, when the option has one.

selected.description: True for the option under the mark.

box_text.description: The text that the input box holds, or null for an empty box.

negative_control_for.description: The slug of the screen that this screen must NOT be confused with.

known_false_positive.description: True when the expected state is wrong on purpose, because the wrong answer is the safe one.

facts.description: The numbers of the facts in facts/ that this screen pins.
